snippet: Three teams on choosing a UI toolkit, and what they would do differently.
body: Three small teams on how they chose a desktop UI toolkit, and what they would do differently next time.
html:
The Pragmatic Weekly · Issue 88

How small teams ship desktop apps

Three small teams on how they chose a desktop UI toolkit, and what they would do differently next time.

The common thread: pick the stack your team can debug at 2am. Two of the three teams moved from a pure web wrapper to a native shell with a web UI, and none of them regret owning their own update channel.

Editor's pick: the team that cut their install size by 80% by dropping a bundled browser.

Read the full issue

Also this week: code signing on a budget and shipping for Windows on ARM.
